description: Add delayed reconnect banner, disabled sending with draft preservation, restored indicator after auth/history readiness, prolonged retry and streaming recovery copy. Extend browser reconnect tests and localized UI strings.

comments.text: Module-context findings: WebWidget adapts LiveView-owned messages to assistant-ui; WidgetContext owns parent handshake and readiness; app.js owns the single transport. Flow: hook disconnect -> browser status store -> React banner/send guard; auth/history mount -> readiness -> restored status. Dependencies: LiveView hooks and live_react UI, no new host transport. State: messages/session server-owned; draft React-owned; connection presentation iframe document lifetime. Contracts: preserve response.* and parent readiness; never resend on reconnect. Risks: stale async ready callbacks, React remount during failed auth, terminal revocation. Coverage: existing reconnect test proves mock admission/reply and history; new assertions will cover offline draft/disabled send/status/retry, streaming banner and failed-auth readiness. Unknown: whether live_react remount clears drafts on failed authentication; verify in browser before deciding preservation changes.

title: Show reconnect status and preserve draft during connection recovery
